citations.A1: `_cache` is populated once per process and there is no invalidation path at all
citations.A2: **Not a fix — TTL/time expiry:** still serves stale values for the whole window
citations.A3: **Not a fix — deleting the cache:** correct but re-opens and re-parses on every call
citations.A4: the cache key ignores `path`, so the first caller's file is returned to every later caller
citations.A5: Not thread-safe: two threads can load concurrently and the check-then-set is racy
citations.A6: The shared mutable dict is handed out directly, so any caller mutating it corrupts every other caller
citations.A7: call `get_config()`, `echo '{"k":2}' > config.json`, call again in the same process, assert the new value — must fail before the fix and pass after
